basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Developmental Psychotherapist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Three posts of Developmental Psychotherapist (on contractual basis) are open at the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP), run by the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 06-12-2026 (4pm). The posts carry a consolidated pay of Rs. 33,000/- P.M.

The mode of appointment is Contract, and the pay is a consolidated Rs. 33,000/- P.M.; the notice names no allowances on top of it. content_sections.heading: About the CDMRP Project
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The vacancy notification, dated 24.11.2026, is issued by the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. The project has posts at CDMRP Calicut University and at a Kannur Unit.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is written on plain paper giving full bio-data. No separate application form is prescribed in the notice. Send it to this address: Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 The application must reach this address on or before 06 December 2026 by 4 pm. The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post or registered post) or anything to be written on the envelope. Write the application on plain paper with full bio-data. Attach a passport size attested photograph. Attach attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents. Send the application so that it reaches the Director- CDMRP at the address above by 4 pm on 06 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All three vacancies are for one post, Developmental Psychotherapist, split between two units of posting. Essential qualification for Developmental Psychotherapist, as printed in the notice: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology / M.Phil. in Rehabilitation Psychology / Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology Valid RCI Certificate The notice does not mention any experience requirement or age limit. The mode of appointment is Contract, and the pay is a consolidated Rs. 33,000/- P.M.; the notice names no allowances on top of it. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data on plain paper Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications will be processed by the Director –CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or the criteria used for shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contractual basis only. Applications must reach the Director- CDMRP by the deadline; the notice gives the date of receipt, not dispatch. Copies of the notice were sent to the PRO, University of Calicut, the Digital Wing for publication on the University website, and the University/ Department Notice Board.

faq.question: Q1. How many Developmental Psychotherapist vacancies are there at Calicut University CDMRP?
faq.answer: There are three (3) vacancies: 1 at CDMRP Calicut University and 2 at the Kannur Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CDMRP Developmental Psychotherapist post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director- CDMRP on or before 06-12-2026 by 4 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Developmental Psychotherapist post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology / M.Phil. in Rehabilitation Psychology / Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology, along with a Valid RCI Certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a CDMRP Developmental Psychotherapist?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 33,000/- P.M.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Calicut University Developmental Psychotherapist post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with full bio-data, a passport size attested photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents to Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the CDMRP post?
faq.answer: The Director –CDMRP will process all applications, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Developmental Psychotherapist job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the mode of appointment is Contract; the post is offered on contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Is an RCI certificate compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a Valid RCI Certificate is listed as part of the essential qualification for the Developmental Psychotherapist post.
